title: CAN Transmit
text: Send serial data to CAN bus, 1 input, 1 output, {Length (bytes)} sets Length of message; {Data format} sets the data output type, {Frame format}, {Identifier Type} sets the message identifier type Standard, {Identifier} sets the message identifier, {Remote Frame} enables remote message, {Enable bit rate switching} enables bit rate switch message and {Output Status} enables output status. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Status of CAN message transmission scalar

params.name: Data format
params.values: Data output type Raw data (default) | CAN Msg

params.name: Frame format
params.values: Frame format type CAN-FD (default) | Classic CAN

params.name: Identifier Type
params.values: Message identifier type Standard (11-bit identifier) (default) | Extended (29-bit identifier)

params.name: Identifier
params.values: Message identifier 100 (default) | numeric identifier of length 11 or 29 bits

params.name: Length (bytes)
params.values: Length of message 64 (default) | positive integer less than or equal to 64(CAN-FD) | positive integer less than or equal to 8(Classic CAN)

params.name: Enable bit rate switching
params.values: Enable bit rate switch message off (default) | on
